configuration.title: Jira Wiki Markup
configuration.preview.theme.enum0: Jira interface colors (light or dark, following the VS Code theme)
configuration.preview.theme.enum1: Colors of the current VS Code theme
configuration.preview.fontSize.descripti: Font size in the preview, in px.
configuration.preview.maxWidth.descripti: Maximum width of the text column in the preview, in px. 0 means unlimited.
configuration.preview.scrollPreviewWithE: Scroll the preview to follow the editor.
configuration.preview.scrollEditorWithPr: Scroll the editor to follow the preview.
configuration.preview.doubleClickToSwitc: Double-clicking in the preview moves the cursor to the matching source line.
configuration.preview.highlightCode.desc: Highlight syntax inside {code:language} blocks. Without a language the code is shown as is.
configuration.spell.enabled.description: Check spelling in Jira files. Dictionaries load into a helper process on the first check and are released after five minutes of inactivity.
configuration.spell.languages.descriptio: Languages to check. The alphabet of each word decides which dictionary is used, so Russian and English text can be mixed freely.
configuration.spell.userWords.descriptio: Words to always accept. Extended by the “Add to dictionary” quick fix.
configuration.spell.minWordLength.descri: Words shorter than this are not checked — they are usually acronyms.
configuration.spell.ignoreAllCaps.descri: Skip words written in capitals, such as API, SQL or CRM.
configuration.baseUrl.description: Base URL of your Jira, for example https://company.atlassian.net. Used to link issue keys like ABC-123 and [~user] mentions.
